title: CIA Triad + Non-repudiation
rows: Only authorized parties can access or read the data
Data is not altered without detection
Systems and data are accessible when legitimately needed
An action cannot be credibly denied by the party who performed it

rows: Attaches to a host file, needs a user to run it to spread

Disguises itself as legitimate software to get installed
Encrypts data and demands payment for the key
Hides deep with admin/kernel rights, survives reboots
Covertly captures input, credentials, or activity

title: Social Engineering Techniques
rows: Phishing targeted at a specific person or executive
Fabricating a plausible scenario to manipulate the target
Registering common misspellings of a legitimate domain
Compromising a site the target is known to visit

description: Collect from most to least volatile.
